tools.name: SynthKeys
tools.tagline: Text expander for signatures, phrases and templates
tools.description: Type a short trigger such as #sig in any app and SynthKeys replaces it with your text. Tray app, AutoHotkey import, snippet chains.
tools.notes:
• Start menu entry can be switched on or off in Settings
• Snippet chains with {snippet:#trigger}
• Export (SynthKeys JSON, AutoHotkey v2) and JSON import
• Sample snippets with safe removal (backup first)
